hoped: I hoped she would see that mistakes don't make her bad.
memorySummary: I spilled the paint and Mama knelt down and said it was okay. I think mistakes happen and I am still good.

repair: I'm sorry I yelled. I was tired and it wasn't your fault.
memorySummary: Mama came back and said sorry for yelling. She said it was not my fault and that she was tired. I felt my chest get less tight.

hoped: I wanted him to know he can always tell me the truth, and that sharing matters.
memorySummary: I told Mama about the broken cup. She was calm. I still do not really know why I had to give my toy to Sam.

hoped: I hoped he would feel safe telling me when he is scared.
memorySummary: I got in trouble for crying. I should hide it next time so nobody gets mad.

repair: I love you no matter what you do.
memorySummary: I remember the big red kite and the wind at the park. Dad let me hold the string.

hoped: I hoped she would learn patience.
